what_it_is: Year-over-year % increase in revenue for each forecast year.
why_this_choice: Branch Process: MODEL14 revenue path = 30%/18%/14.5%/11%/8.5%. MODEL15 = 32%/20%/16%/12%/9% — extends Q3 Scores +41% / B2B +49% mortgage unit-price momentum (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/814547/000081454726000031/exhibit991erq32026.htm). Terminal g 3.5%→3.75%. In Model 14, growth was 30.0%/18.0%/14.5%/11.0%/8.5%; in Model 15 it is 32.0%/20.0%/16.0%/12.0%/9.0% because Q3 Scores +41% / B2B +49% mortgage unit-price momentum (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/814547/000081454726000031/exhibit991erq32026.htm) and royalty $4.95→$10.00.
source: Equifax / Hawley — FICO 2026 mortgage royalty 2x; EX-99.1 Q3 FY2026 guidance

what_it_is: Cost of revenues as a % of sales (gross margin = 1 − this).
how_set_in_model: Excel: MAX(8%, segment blended COGS base≈12.98% − 150bps × year). GM_B2B = 97% (Scores OM ~91%).
why_this_choice: In Model 14, COGS grind was −120 bps with a 10% floor; in Model 15, grind is −150 bps with floor 8% because IR Scores OM ~91% means Software/PS must not cap the royalty coupon (https://investors.fico.com/static-files/66ef723c-1f2e-4501-a452-ab2f3d02ae85). Branch Process: MODEL14 COGS −120 / SG&A −175 / R&D −50 bps (COGS floor 10%). MODEL15 COGS −150 / SG&A −200 / R&D −75 bps; COGS floor 8%; GM_B2B 97% (Scores OM ~91%). Mortgage royalty $4.95→$10.00.
source: FICO IR deck — Scores OM ~91%; SEC 10-K Scores unit price

what_it_is: Operating opex (SG&A) as % of sales.
how_set_in_model: Equation: MAX(13%, (I28 − 10,922)/I24 − 200bps × year). Strips FY25 restructuring; then −2.00% of sales each year.
why_this_choice: In Model 14, SG&A was −175 bps / 14% floor; in Model 15, −200 bps / 13% floor because B2B mortgage royalty hikes need ~0 incremental SG&A (Scores OM ~91%).
source: FICO IR deck Scores OM; Equifax/Hawley mortgage royalty 2x

what_it_is: Research & development expense as % of sales (IS label: R&D, not Rent).
how_set_in_model: Excel: MAX(6%, I29/I24 − 75bps × year).
why_this_choice: In Model 14, R&D faded −50 bps; in Model 15, −75 bps (floor 6%) because mortgage/B2B royalty dollars require ~0 incremental R&D — do not let Software R&D tax the Scores coupon.
source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — Research and development; Scores royalty economics

what_it_is: Total depreciation & amortization as % of sales (software-industry driver).
how_set_in_model: Yellow POLICY input: flat 0.84% (3yr FY23–25 avg TOTAL D&A). Forecast DA$ = Revenue × DA%; CF row 63 adds it back once.
why_this_choice: MODEL15: TOTAL D&A add-back ≈ 0.84% of Rev (3yr avg). Intangibles amort included once.
source: SEC companyfacts — DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization (+ AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets)

what_it_is: Interest expense as % of opening debt balance.
how_set_in_model: Excel equation: I101/I98 (FY25 interest ÷ FY25 opening debt in schedule).
why_this_choice: Approximates average coupon / cost of debt on the book. Debt stock follows the net debt issuance assumption (row 19).
source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — Interest expense; see also 8-K 6.250% notes

what_it_is: Effective book tax rate applied to forecast EBT → Net Income.
how_set_in_model: Excel equation: I35/I33 (FY25 tax ÷ simplified FY25 EBT in this template).
why_this_choice: Book rate (~19%) remains on the income statement. DCF unlevered cash taxes use a separate cash tax rate (22.87% = 3yr IncomeTaxesPaidNet/EBT). Keep 3yr cash tax IncomeTaxesPaidNet/EBT ≈ 22.87% (not silently cut). Guided book ETR ~24–26% is not a cash-tax shortcut without XBRL support.
source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — tax expense; cash taxes from IncomeTaxesPaidNet

what_it_is: Days Sales Outstanding. AR = Revenue × DSO / 365.
how_set_in_model: Yellow POLICY path: phases 97d (FY25 hist) → 32d over 5 years (Y1≈84.0d … Y5=32d). Segment blend ref ≈ 27.5d on schedule row 115 (SaaS 40/B2C 2/B2B 25/PS 12/On-prem 40).
why_this_choice: In Model 14, DSO targeted 35d; in Model 15, target is 32d (MODEL14 rated 7/10) so cash matches Scores settlement / SaaS upfront reality. Branch Process MODEL14→MODEL15: Op NWC = AR+Inv−AP (excludes Deferred) unchanged. DSO target 32d (MODEL14 was 35d) — faster Scores/SaaS cash. ΔDeferred remains an explicit CFO/FCFF source (row 81). No AR/unearned double-count. Deferred stays in Total Liab; +ΔDeferred is explicit in CFO/FCFF (not in Op NWC). FY25 deferred ≈ $187.4M. Detail: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/814547/000081454726000011/R45.htm.
source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — AR; Q1 FY2026 deferred detail

what_it_is: Inventory days (Inv = COGS × days/365).
how_set_in_model: Hard zero — FICO is software / scores; inventory is immaterial.
why_this_choice: No inventory cycle to fund.
source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — Inventory ≈ $0

what_it_is: Days Payable Outstanding. AP = COGS × DPO / 365.
how_set_in_model: Excel equation: ROUND(I48/I25×365, 0) from FY25; held flat.
why_this_choice: MODEL15: DPO pairs with phased DSO for Op NWC = AR+Inv−AP. Deferred is a SEPARATE CFO cash source (row 81) — never mixed into AR/DPO.
source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — Accounts payable

what_it_is: Capital investment (PPE + capitalized software) as % of sales.
how_set_in_model: Yellow POLICY path: 1.00% / 0.80% / 0.60% / 0.45% / 0.35% (Scores-light fade — royalties need ~0 CapEx).
why_this_choice: In Model 14, CapEx faded 1.25%→0.60% of TOTAL rev; in Model 15, path is 1.00%→0.80%→0.60%→0.45%→0.35% so Software CapEx does not tax the Scores coupon. Branch Process: MODEL14 CapEx 1.25%→0.60% of TOTAL rev. MODEL15 Scores-light path 1.00% → 0.80% → 0.60% → 0.45% → 0.35% — mortgage/B2B royalty hikes need ~0 CapEx; do not tax the Scores coupon with Software capitalization.
source: SEC 10-K / companyfacts — PPE purchases + capitalized software; IR Scores OM

what_it_is: New borrowing (+) that funds buybacks above annual FCF ($000s).
how_set_in_model: Equation: (1.40−1)×(CFO−CapEx) so excess buybacks are debt-financed and ΔCash≈0.
why_this_choice: In Model 14, debt was a fixed 3yr run-rate and buybacks were residual FCF (≈1.0×); in Model 15, debt = (1.40−1)×FCF because Q3 FY2026 buybacks $1.96B vs FCF $370M prove leverage is used (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/814547/000081454726000031/exhibit991erq32026.htm). Branch Process: MODEL14 used residual FCF after fixed debt run-rate (≈1.0×). MODEL15 buybacks = 1.40× (CFO−CapEx); incremental debt funds the (MULT−1) portion so ΔCash≈0. Anchored to Q3 FY2026: buybacks $1960M vs FCF $370.3M (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/814547/000081454726000031/exhibit991erq32026.htm). Excluded from FCFF.
source: SEC EX-99.1 Q3 FY2026 — FCF vs buybacks; companyfacts debt CF

what_it_is: Buybacks (−) in the forecast BS/CF — can exceed annual FCF via leverage.
how_set_in_model: Equation: −1.40×(CFO−CapEx). Hist 3yr avg buybacks ≈ $881M/yr; Q3 alone $1.96B.
why_this_choice: In Model 14, buybacks = residual FCF after fixed debt; in Model 15, buybacks = 1.40×(CFO−CapEx) so share count falls faster. Financing excluded from FCFF. Start shares 21,597.635k; price $1,149. Shares fall with EquityCF (buybacks). SBC add-back does NOT dilute. Levered buybacks accelerate share shrink vs MODEL14 residual-only.
source: SEC EX-99.1 Q3 FY2026 — buybacks $1.96B / 1.705M sh @ $1,149

what_it_is: Stock-based compensation as % of sales; non-cash add-back in CFO and FCFF.
how_set_in_model: Yellow POLICY path: 8.25% / 7.70% / 7.20% / 6.80% / 6.40% (FY1 starts at hist 3yr avg 8.25%).
why_this_choice: In Model 14, SBC was flat 8.25% of total Rev; in Model 15, SBC% fades because royalty price dollars do not require 1:1 SBC. Branch Process: MODEL14 held SBC flat at 8.251% of total Rev. MODEL15 fades SBC% 8.25% / 7.70% / 7.20% / 6.80% / 6.40% because royalty price dollars do not require 1:1 SBC. Add-back once in CFO/FCFF; shares fall only via buybacks (start 21,597.6k post–Q3).
source: SEC 10-K cash flow — ShareBasedCompensation (add-back only; no share dilution)

what_it_is: Share of Total Revenue from SaaS / cloud software (incl. FICO Platform cloud).
how_set_in_model: FY25 base 21.08% (SaaS $419,720k / Total $1,990,869k), then +250 bps/yr taken from on-prem. Platform ARR KPI $263.6M is not additive IS revenue.
why_this_choice: SaaS billed annually in advance → Deferred Revenue growth → explicit CFO cash source (3S row 81). Source: Q1 FY2026 10-Q deferred roll-forward (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/814547/000081454726000011/fico-20251231.htm). Mix offsets within Total Rev — not a second revenue line.
source: SEC 10-Q Q1 FY2026 — Deferred revenue / contract liabilities detail

what_it_is: Share of Total Revenue from B2C scoring / myFICO.com subscriptions.
how_set_in_model: Yellow POLICY = 11.05% (FY25 B2C Scores $219,980k / Total $1,990,869k).
why_this_choice: Near-zero DSO (card-settled consumer subscriptions). Minimal Deferred Revenue vs annual SaaS invoices. High incremental margin; WC-light cash conversion.
source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — Scores segment B2C / myFICO disaggregation

what_it_is: Share of Total Revenue from B2B scoring (mortgage, auto, card via CRAs).

source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — Scores segment B2B disaggregation

how_set_in_model: Yellow POLICY = 4.13% (FY25 PS $82,149k / Total $1,990,869k).

source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — Software segment Professional services line

how_set_in_model: Yellow POLICY = 16.09% (FY25 on-prem $320,425k / Total $1,990,869k).
why_this_choice: With SaaS mix, drives Deferred Revenue (maintenance billed in advance). Same 45-day DSO policy as SaaS. Completes mix identity to 100% of Total Rev.
source: SEC 10-K FY2025 — Software on-premises vs SaaS deployment table

what_it_is: Cash tax rate used for FCFF unlevered taxes and after-tax cost of debt.

source: Yacktman AAA-equity framework; CAPM ref FRED/Damodaran/Yahoo/8-K

source: VCP Scanner FICO peer EV/EBITDA comps + Yacktman premium

ΔDeferred remains an explicit CFO/FCFF source (row 81). No AR/unearned double-count. Deferred stays in Total Liab; +ΔDeferred is explicit in CFO/FCFF (not in Op NWC). FY25 deferred ≈ $187.4M.
